name: @coreyuan/vector-mind
description: VectorMind MCP: requirement-driven context memory linking file changes to developer intent.
author: yuanfeng-net

scripts.admin:dev: npm run build && npm --prefix admin-panel run dev
scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc && node --input-type=module -e "import { chmodSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const f of ['dist/index.js','dist/rtk-shim.js']) try { chmodSync(f, 0o755); } catch {}"
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke:run
scripts.smoke:run: node scripts/smoke/admin-launcher-cases.mjs && node scripts/smoke/security-regression-cases.mjs && node scripts/smoke/checkpoint-regression-cases.mjs && node scripts/smoke/operation-regression-cases.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run license:check && npm run readme:check && npm run build && npm --prefix admin-panel run check && npm run smoke:run
